phases.name: Fresh dictionary acquisition from span-eight enumeration
Six fresh auxiliary anchor solves and checks (two unused)

base_dictionary_input: Enumerated span-eight words; no prior solved response packet. Previously written compiler code and predetermined enrichment settings reused.
limitations: Sum of recorded stages, not a single end-to-end stopwatch. One BLAS thread; installed compilation caches may be used. Research, exploratory parameter selection, development, experimental acquisition and later diagnostic reruns are excluded. All six anchors counted, including two not used in final global cover. Acquisition costs separately in policy/acquisition JSON.
